name: Lisa Blunt Rochester
stance: Calls for public Senate Commerce hearings with AI CEOs after rogue-agent and hacking incidents, has pressed OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta on safety, and says even a small chance of AI wiping out humanity warrants slowing down.

statements.text: Recent “autonomous hackings” show there’s still so much we don’t know about AI.
Pressed OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta for answers on how they will keep communities safe after recent AI hacking incidents.
Even if there was a 1% chance AI could wipe out human life, we should be pumping the brakes to make sure we have the proper safeguards in place, not racing blindly into disaster.
With Sen. John Curtis, called on the Senate Commerce Committee to hold immediate public hearings with AI CEOs on frontier AI risks.
AI is out of control and the American people deserve answers.
Republicans control the House and the Senate – if they wanted, we could be taking action to respond to these alarming escalations right now.
The AI race is out of control and our president is rambling on about how we talk about it.
It’s time for leading AI companies to come before Congress and explain to the American people what’s happening and how they’ll keep us safe as this technology evolves.
